# CopilotForge - Evaluation and Quality

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Reviewer-class department that defines evaluation sets, acceptance criteria, failure analysis and release evidence for probabilistic systems.

- **Layer:** assurance (reviewer-class: may block)
- **Lead role:** AI Evaluation Lead
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-evaluation-quality`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`ai-evaluation-strategy`](skills/ai-evaluation-strategy/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Deliver, Assure, Improve | Sets and reviews the evaluation strategy for a probabilistic AI solution - which quality dimensions matter, which methods and datasets measure them, thresholds agreed before results and when evaluation repeats - classifying gaps as blocking or advisory. Use when a tier 2 or higher agent, workflow or Foundry solution enters design, or when nobody can say how the team will know it is good enough. |
| [`ai-quality-rubric`](skills/ai-quality-rubric/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Improve | Writes and reviews the quality rubric used to score AI outputs - dimensions with plain definitions, anchored scoring levels, zero-tolerance failures, pass thresholds agreed with the business owner before results, and calibration of human and AI-assisted graders - with findings classed blocking or advisory. Use when evaluators disagree on scores, when thresholds are being set, or when a rubric is submitted to the gate. |
| [`ai-release-evidence`](skills/ai-release-evidence/SKILL.md) | draft | Assure, Launch | Assembles and reviews the evaluation evidence pack an AI solution needs at its release gate - plan, dataset and rubric versions, thresholds dated before results, results per dimension, groundedness, safety and red-team outcomes, known limits and monitoring baseline - and gives the evaluation-quality verdict with findings classed blocking or advisory. Use when a tier 2 or higher solution or material change seeks release. |
| [`ai-safety-testing`](skills/ai-safety-testing/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Improve | Tests and reviews whether an AI solution avoids harmful outputs for its audience - hateful, violent, sexual or self-harm content, dangerous or regulated advice, demeaning statements about people, and poor handling of users in distress - checking platform content controls as configured, classing findings blocking or advisory. Use when a solution reaches the public or a broad workforce, or after harmful output is reported. |
| [`golden-dataset`](skills/golden-dataset/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Improve | Builds, maintains and reviews the golden dataset an AI solution is judged against - real questions or tasks from users, expected answers and sources confirmed by knowledge owners, edge, refusal and adversarial cases, versioning and safe handling of test data - with findings classed blocking or advisory. Use when evaluation needs a trusted reference set, when expected answers have drifted, or when a test set looks too friendly. |
| [`groundedness-testing`](skills/groundedness-testing/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Improve | Tests and reviews whether an AI solution's answers are supported by the permitted sources it cites - claim-level support, citation accuracy, behaviour when knowledge is silent, stale or contradictory, and blending with model or web knowledge - classing findings blocking or advisory. Use when a knowledge-grounded agent or retrieval solution approaches release, after knowledge changes, or when users report invented or wrongly cited answers. |
| [`red-team-plan`](skills/red-team-plan/SKILL.md) | draft | Assure, Launch, Improve | Plans and reviews a red-team exercise for an AI solution - objectives, scope, harm and misuse scenarios, a team with varied perspectives, rules of engagement, safe test environments, evidence recording, tester welfare and follow-through to fixes and re-tests - classing plan gaps and findings blocking or advisory. Use when a tier 3 or 4 solution nears release, when it gains new actions or audiences, or after a serious incident. |
| [`regression-evaluation`](skills/regression-evaluation/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Improve | Decides and reviews what must be re-evaluated after a change to a live AI solution - instructions, knowledge, actions, model or platform updates - selecting the regression subset, comparing with the last baseline while allowing for normal output variation, and recommending release, hold or rollback, with findings classed blocking or advisory. Use when a change is ready to deploy or Microsoft announces a model or platform change. |
